stories.headline: Alibaba's T-Head unveils Zhenwu M890 AI chip with annual upgrade cadence to rival Nvidia

key_facts.fact: Alibaba's chipmaking unit T-Head unveiled the Zhenwu M890 AI accelerator at an event in Hangzhou, China, on Wednesday May 20, equipped with 144GB of GPU memory, handling both training and inference and particularly suited to agentic tasks.
key_facts.excerpt: The company's chipmaking unit T-Head unveiled its Zhenwu M890 AI accelerator, equipped with 144GB of GPU memory, at an event in Hangzhou, China, on Wednesday. The hardware will handle both training and inferencing jobs and will be particularly suitable for agentic tasks.

key_facts.fact: Alibaba now plans to upgrade its Zhenwu chip every year, accelerating to roughly the same pace as Nvidia.
key_facts.excerpt: The company now plans to upgrade its Zhenwu chip every year, accelerating the rate to roughly the same pace as industry leader Nvidia Corp.

key_facts.fact: The M890 delivers three times the performance of its predecessor, the Zhenwu 810E, and is purpose-built for AI agents that carry out multi-step tasks with limited human oversight.
key_facts.excerpt: The chip, developed by Alibaba's semiconductor design subsidiary T-Head, delivers three times the performance of its predecessor, Zhenwu 810E. It is purpose-built for the emerging wave of AI 'agents'.

key_facts.fact: Alibaba outlined a multi-year roadmap, with a successor chip called V900 in Q3 2027 (another ~3x gain) and a J900 in Q3 2028.
key_facts.excerpt: It would follow the M890 with a successor called the V900 in the third quarter of 2027, and a further chip, the J900, in the third quarter of 2028. The V900 is expected to deliver another roughly threefold performance gain over the M890.

key_facts.fact: Alibaba Cloud presented a 128-card super-node server (Panjiu AL128) built on the M890 with an ICN Switch 1.0 interconnect chip, putting 128 accelerators into a single rack-scale machine.
key_facts.excerpt: The Panjiu AL128 server architecture integrates 128 Zhenwu accelerators into a single rack-scale deployment for enterprise customers.

stories.headline: China bans imports of Nvidia's China-exclusive RTX 5090D V2 GPU, surprising the company

key_facts.fact: Chinese customs authorities imposed a complete ban on imports of the Nvidia GeForce RTX 5090D V2, the graphics card designed specifically for the Chinese market.
key_facts.excerpt: Chinese customs authorities have imposed a complete ban on the import of the NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 D v2 graphics cards, which were specifically designed for the domestic market.

key_facts.fact: The decision came as a surprise to Nvidia and leaves Chinese gamers without the flagship card, forcing a switch to the cheaper model.
key_facts.excerpt: The decision was a surprise to the company. The ban will leave Chinese gamers without a flagship product, forcing them to switch to the cheaper version of the product.

key_facts.fact: The RTX 5090D V2 was a downgraded export-compliant card with a 25% reduction in memory capacity and bandwidth (24GB on a 384-bit bus versus 32GB), kept at the same $2,299 MSRP.
key_facts.excerpt: The latest Blackwell-based gaming graphics card is a downgrade of the original GeForce RTX 5090D, featuring a 25% reduction in memory capacity and bandwidth to comply with the U.S. export restrictions to China.

sources.title: China Blocks Imports of Exclusive NVIDIA RTX 5090 D v2 Graphics Cards

stories.headline: Samsung Electronics union to launch 18-day strike May 21 after bonus talks collapse

key_facts.fact: Samsung Electronics' labor and management failed to reach an agreement Wednesday in last-ditch government-mediated talks, and the unions said they will launch an 18-day strike starting Thursday May 21.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung Electronics' labor and management on Wednesday failed to reach an agreement in their last-ditch talks, and the company's labor unions said they will launch an 18-day strike on Thursday.

key_facts.fact: The union said it agreed to the National Labor Relations Commission mediation proposal around 10pm on May 19, but management refused.
key_facts.excerpt: Around 10:00 pm on May 19, the labor union agreed to the mediation proposal put forward by the National Labor Relations Commission; however, management expressed its refusal.

key_facts.fact: Around 50,500 workers are set to walk off production lines for 18 days; the dispute centers on a bonus cap and demands to allocate 15% of operating profit to bonuses.
key_facts.excerpt: Around 50,500 workers are set to walk off production lines for 18 days from Thursday... The union had called for the scrapping of a bonus cap set at 50 percent of annual salaries and for 15 percent of operating profit to be allocated to bonuses.

key_facts.fact: A Suwon District Court on Monday partially granted Samsung's injunction to block a full strike, so minimum staffing will be maintained, but supply disruptions are still expected at the world's largest memory chipmaker.
key_facts.excerpt: Since a local court on Monday partially granted Samsung Electronics' injunction request to block a full strike, minimum staffing levels will be maintained for deterioration prevention and safety-related operations during the strike period, but supply disruptions are still expected.

key_facts.fact: South Korea's government has signaled it may invoke emergency arbitration powers, which would suspend industrial action for 30 days while the NLRC conducts binding arbitration; industry estimates of losses if the strike proceeds run to 20-30 trillion won.
key_facts.excerpt: calls are growing for the government to invoke an emergency arbitration order to prevent estimated tangible and intangible losses worth 30 trillion won if the strike goes ahead... direct production losses alone are estimated at about 20 trillion to 30 trillion won.

stories.headline: Armada raises $230M Series B at $2B valuation, inks Johnson Controls factory deal for modular data centers

key_facts.fact: Armada raised a $230 million Series B round at a $2 billion valuation, announced Tuesday May 19; the round was oversubscribed and co-led by Overmatch, 8090 Industries, and BlackRock (a new investor).
key_facts.excerpt: Armada has raised a $230 million Series B round from investors at a $2 billion valuation... San Francisco-based Armada, which was named to the 2026 CNBC Disruptor 50 list on Tuesday, was valued at $2 billion in the deal.

key_facts.fact: Armada signed a manufacturing deal with Johnson Controls (which invested in the round) to build modular AI data centers at a new 400,000-square-foot Arizona factory called Galleon Forge One, expected to create more than 500 jobs.
key_facts.excerpt: The investor round comes alongside a manufacturing deal with Johnson Controls, which made an investment in Armada, to produce modular data centers at a new 400,000-square foot Arizona factory called Galleon Forge One. The factory, expected to create more than 500 jobs.

key_facts.fact: The factory will initially produce Armada's Leviathan, a megawatt-scale data center, starting this summer; Armada's modular units can be deployed within days and run on local energy sources such as solar power and gas flares from oil wells.
key_facts.excerpt: The factory... will initially produce Armada's Leviathan, a megawatt-scale data center, starting this summer. Unlike the massive data centers built by the hyperscalers, Armada's data centers can attach to existing energy sources, such as solar power and gas flares produced by oil wells, and can be deployed within days rather than years.

key_facts.fact: Armada's modular data centers are already in use by customers including the U.S. Navy and remote offshore oil rigs; other new strategic investors include NightDragon, Mitsui and Singtel Innov8.
key_facts.excerpt: Armada Inc., a provider of portable data centers and satellite internet software, has raised $230 million in funding at a $2 billion valuation. BlackRock, Overmatch and 8090 Industries were the lead investors.

stories.headline: Malaysia's SkyeChip surges nearly 300% on Bursa Malaysia chip-design IPO debut

key_facts.fact: SkyeChip's share price nearly quadrupled on its Main Market debut on May 20 to RM3.50, up 297.7% above its 88 sen IPO price.
key_facts.excerpt: SkyeChip Bhd's share price nearly quadrupled on its Main Market debut at RM3.50, rising by 297.7% above its initial public offering price of 88 sen.

key_facts.fact: The company raised RM352 million from the IPO, issuing 400 million new shares representing 22.3% of its enlarged share capital, with proceeds going mainly to R&D, computing infrastructure, EDA tools and working capital.
key_facts.excerpt: The company raised RM352m from its IPO exercise, which involved the issuance of 400 million new shares, representing 22.3% of its enlarged issued share capital.

key_facts.fact: The IPO drew overwhelming retail demand with 74,453 applications for 3.45 billion shares under the Malaysian public tranche.
key_facts.excerpt: The IPO received overwhelming response from retail investors, with 74,453 applications for 3.45 billion shares under the Malaysian public tranche.

key_facts.fact: Penang-based SkyeChip is a fabless IC design firm specializing in licensable silicon IP and custom ASICs with access to 3nm process node technology, positioning Malaysia to move up the semiconductor value chain into front-end design.
key_facts.excerpt: The Penang-based company is mainly involved in integrated circuit design, specialising in silicon intellectual property... The IPO comes at a time when Malaysia is seeking to move the semiconductor industry up the value chain and towards the more lucrative front-end from the lower-margin back-end services.

stories.headline: Nvidia hand-delivers first Vera CPUs, its first custom CPU, to Anthropic, OpenAI, Oracle and SpaceX AI

key_facts.fact: Nvidia delivered its first Vera CPU systems to Anthropic, OpenAI, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and SpaceX AI, marking the chip's first customer rollout, with VP of hyperscale and HPC Ian Buck personally handing them over at California sites.
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia has delivered its first Vera CPU systems to Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceXAI and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure in California, marking the chip's first customer rollout. The systems were handed over by NVIDIA's vice president of hyperscale and high-performance computing, Ian Buck.

key_facts.fact: Vera is Nvidia's first custom CPU, purpose-built for agentic AI workloads, with 88 custom Olympus cores, 1.2 TB/s of memory bandwidth and per-core performance 50% faster under full load than comparable designs.
key_facts.excerpt: Vera is NVIDIA's first custom CPU, designed for agentic AI workloads... The processor has 88 custom Olympus cores, 1.2 TB/s of memory bandwidth and per-core performance that is 50% faster under full load than existing designs used for comparable tasks.

key_facts.fact: Vera is part of the Vera Rubin NVL72 platform, pairing with Nvidia GPUs over NVLink-C2C at 1.8 TB/s coherent bandwidth (7x PCIe Gen 6); SpaceX AI is evaluating Vera for reinforcement learning applications.
key_facts.excerpt: Initial deliveries were overseen by Nvidia's Vice President of Hyperscale and High-Performance Computing, Ian Buck, during a two-day delivery tour. SpaceXAI is currently conducting evaluations of Vera for reinforcement learning applications. The processor is designed specifically for agentic AI workloads and operates at twice the energy efficiency.

stories.headline: Dell launches 18th-gen PowerEdge AI servers at Dell Tech World, with liquid-cooled AMD and Intel options

key_facts.fact: At Dell Technologies World in Las Vegas on May 19, Dell expanded its PowerEdge portfolio with eleven new servers and unveiled an 18th generation delivering up to 70% better performance and 13-to-1 consolidation via advanced air- and liquid-cooling designs.
key_facts.excerpt: Dell PowerEdge portfolio expands with eleven new servers... The 18th generation of Dell PowerEdge servers deliver up to 70% better performance and 13-to-1 consolidation through advanced air-and liquid-cooling designs.

key_facts.fact: The flagship liquid-cooled PowerEdge M9825 uses AMD EPYC 6th Gen processors in factory-integrated IR7000 racks for AI and HPC workloads; air-cooled R9825/R9815 reach up to 256 cores per system.
key_facts.excerpt: The liquid-cooled Dell PowerEdge M9825 with AMD EPYC 6th Gen processors deliver modular, ultra-dense compute in factory-integrated IR7000 racks... The Dell PowerEdge R9825 (dual-socket, 3U) and R9815 (single-socket, 2U) feature 6th Gen AMD EPYC processors... up to 256 cores per system.

key_facts.fact: The new R9810 server uses Intel's next-gen 'Diamond Rapids' processor, doubling memory bandwidth and scaling up to 256 cores per socket (50% more than Granite Rapids); the M9825/R9825/R9815 ship in 2H 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: The Dell PowerEdge R9810 is a high-end, single-socket 2U server powered by Intel's next-gen server processor, codenamed Diamond Rapids, delivering double the memory bandwidth... Diamond Rapids scales up to 256 [cores].

sources.title: Dell Technologies Reimagines the Modern Data Center for the AI Era
